content: Our paper on *Equivariant Neural Operators for Fluid Dynamics* was accepted at **ICML 2026** (Oral Presentation, top 1.8%)!
Delivered an invited seminar at the **Institute for Pure and Applied Mathematics (IPAM)** at UCLA on *Geometric Deep Learning for PDE Solvers*.
Awarded the **Outstanding Postdoctoral Research Fellowship** in Artificial Intelligence by the National Science Foundation.
New preprint available on arXiv: *Provable Generalization Bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Networks* with Prof. Elena Rostova.
Serving as Area Chair for **NeurIPS 2025** Machine Learning and the Physical Sciences Workshop.
